appDesc.message: Sends browser downloads and media to Falcon DM.

fabDismiss.message: Hide download button for this page

fabDismissHint.message: Hidden until you refresh the page or open another video

fabDragHint.message: Drag to move · click to download

youtubeHint.message: YouTube: Falcon captures the signed CDN link from this tab. Pick Video+Audio for sound.

videoOnlyHint.message: This source has no audio. Pick a Video+Audio card if you want sound.

qualityHint.message: Choose quality and format. HLS streams are merged automatically by Falcon DM.

errorJunkUrl.message: Not a real video URL — play the video and pick a quality card

errorWaking.message: Falcon DM did not start. Open it manually.

errorMediaUtils.message: Falcon module failed to load — reload extension

errorNoActiveTab.message: No browser tab — click the page, then try again

errorAppOffline.message: Falcon DM is not running — open the desktop app

errorTokenInvalid.message: Connection lost — Falcon DM will pair again automatically

errorExtensionBlocked.message: This extension is not approved in Falcon DM

errorInvalidUrl.message: No valid video URL — try another source

errorUnsupportedMagnet.message: Magnet and BitTorrent links are not supported yet

errorNoValidSource.message: No downloadable URL — play the video and try again

errorRateLimit.message: Too many requests — try again shortly

appClosedFallback.message: Falcon DM offline — using browser download

interceptQueued.message: Browser download cancelled — queued in Falcon DM (file saves in Falcon, not Chrome Downloads)

grabberEmpty.message: No downloadable links found on this page

optionsDesc.message: Send downloads from your browser to Falcon DM.

errorPairPending.message: Approve the code in Falcon DM, then try again.

errorPairRejected.message: Falcon DM declined the request. Try again to get a new code.

optionsConnectedDetail.message: Downloads go to the desktop app.

optionsPairing.message: Look for the code in the popup and approve it in Falcon DM.

optionsFallback.message: Let Chrome download when Falcon DM is closed

optionsFallbackHint.message: When off, a download Falcon DM cannot take is cancelled — click the link again once Falcon DM is running.

optionsNotifySuccess.message: Notify when a download is sent to Falcon DM

optionsNotifySuccessHint.message: When off, only errors show notifications.

popupOfflineText.message: Downloads go to the desktop app. Start it to continue.

popupPendingTitle.message: Approve this code in Falcon DM

popupPendingText.message: Falcon DM shows the same code. Approve it there to connect.

popupBlockedText.message: Falcon DM declined this extension or disconnected it.

popupCapture.message: Send browser downloads to Falcon DM

popupCaptureHint.message: When off, Chrome downloads files itself.
